mentions.name: pyreqwest
mentions.description: A high-performance Python HTTP client backed by Rust's reqwest. It offers async and sync APIs, an ergonomic interface similar to reqwest, full type hints, and built-in testing/mocking, with no unsafe code and no Python-side dependencies.
mentions.problem: Started out of frustration with the many issues in the existing Python HTTP client httpx.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building pyreqwest, a high-performance Python HTTP client backed by Rust’s reqwest. It has gotten quite feature rich: async and sync APIs, similar ergonomic interface of reqwest, full type hints, and built-in testing/mocking. It has no unsafe code, and no Python-side dependencies.
